{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Satin-blouse with a V-neck, relaxed fit, knee-length tunic hem, ivory, #f5f0e6, silk blend
Wide-leg trousers, tailored straight cut, floor length, charcoal grey, #3a3d42, wool crepe
Sheath midi-dress, fitted silhouette just below the knee, deep emerald green, #043b27, heavy jacquard weave
Strappy pumps, narrow heel height 8cm, polished leather, rose gold metallic, #b76e59, calf skin

This ensemble balances the semi-formal demands of an autumn wedding reception with your personal comfort and style. The satin blouse paired with structured wide-leg trousers creates a sophisticated yet relaxed silhouette suitable for an evening restaurant setting at 19:00. The rich emerald green jacquard dress offers a backup option that aligns perfectly with the seasonal palette while maintaining the required formal elegance without feeling overly stiff or restrictive."}
